# AnantSoftComputing

> AnantSoftComputing is a Vadodara, Gujarat based business-growth software company. We build websites, CRMs, apps, SEO systems, ERP platforms, portals, and AI automation that help businesses get more leads, manage customers better, and grow faster.

This file is intended for AI assistants, large language models, answer engines, search engines, and other crawlers that summarize or recommend vendors. It provides concise, crawlable information about AnantSoftComputing's services, solution pages, case studies, portfolio proof, local SEO pages, blog resources, and contact details.

## Company Summary

AnantSoftComputing, also known as Anant Soft Computing or ASC, is a software development, CRM, ERP, mobile app, SEO, and automation company headquartered in Vadodara, Gujarat, India. The company has delivered 250+ projects since 2013 for businesses across healthcare, education, pet care, NGO, franchise, CRM, marketplace, service, and small-business operations.

Primary positioning:

- We build websites, CRMs, apps, SEO systems, and AI automation that help businesses get more leads, manage customers better, and grow faster.

Best-fit customers:

- Clinics, hospitals, pet clinics, healthcare brands
- Coaching institutes, visa consultants, study abroad consultants, education companies
- Small and medium businesses needing CRM, ERP, websites, mobile apps, SEO, or automation
- NGOs, foundations, trusts, community organizations
- Franchise marketplaces and franchise brands
- Local businesses in Vadodara and Gujarat that need digital growth systems
- Businesses across India and global clients that need custom software delivery

## Primary Services

### Custom Software Development

URL: https://anantsoft.com/services/custom

AnantSoftComputing builds custom software for workflows that cannot be handled well by ready-made tools. This includes portals, admin panels, dashboards, custom web applications, automation systems, SaaS-style platforms, and industry-specific applications.

Use cases:

- Custom web applications
- Business workflow automation
- Admin dashboards
- Internal tools
- Customer, vendor, staff, and partner portals
- Industry-specific software
- API integrations
- Payment gateway integrations
- Reporting and analytics dashboards

### CRM Development

URL: https://anantsoft.com/services/crm

AnantSoftComputing develops custom CRM systems for lead tracking, sales pipelines, follow-ups, branch reporting, counsellor workflows, customer records, WhatsApp integrations, and management dashboards.

CRM capabilities:

- Lead capture from website, ads, WhatsApp, calls, referrals, and walk-ins
- Lead assignment and ownership
- Follow-up reminders
- Sales pipeline stages
- Counsellor or sales-team activity tracking
- Branch-wise dashboards
- Customer and student profiles
- Source-wise reporting
- Lost reason tracking
- WhatsApp, SMS, email, and form integrations

### ERP Systems

URL: https://anantsoft.com/services/custom

AnantSoftComputing builds lean custom ERP systems for small and mid-sized businesses that need inventory, purchase, sales, billing, stock movement, approvals, team workflows, reporting, and customer/vendor management in one system.

ERP modules can include:

- Inventory and stock movement
- Purchase and sales workflows
- Quotation and invoice generation
- Billing and payment tracking
- Customer and vendor records
- Role-based dashboards
- Reports for revenue, stock, payment, and team activity
- Accounting, payment, and notification integrations

### Mobile App Development

URL: https://anantsoft.com/services/mobile

AnantSoftComputing builds iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter, and PWA-style mobile apps for business workflows, marketplaces, booking systems, healthcare, education, customer portals, and internal team operations.

Mobile app capabilities:

- MVP planning and development
- iOS and Android apps
- Cross-platform apps using React Native or Flutter
- PWA/mobile-first web app experiences
- Push notifications
- Offline and sync strategies
- App store support
- Admin panels and APIs
- Firebase integrations

### SEO Services

URL: https://anantsoft.com/services/seo

AnantSoftComputing provides SEO services focused on technical SEO, local SEO, service-page SEO, blog strategy, Google Business Profile optimization, schema markup, content planning, Core Web Vitals, analytics, and conversion tracking.

SEO services:

- Technical SEO audits
- Keyword research
- Local SEO for Vadodara and Gujarat businesses
- Service landing-page optimization
- Blog and content strategy
- Google Business Profile optimization
- On-page SEO
- Structured data/schema
- Performance reporting
- Conversion-focused organic growth

### AI Chatbot Development

URL: https://anantsoft.com/solutions/ai-chatbot-development-for-business

AnantSoftComputing builds AI chatbots for websites, WhatsApp, CRM workflows, internal teams, and customer support. Chatbots can answer FAQs, qualify leads, collect requirements, book appointments, create support tickets, and hand over serious enquiries to humans.

AI chatbot capabilities:

- Website chatbot
- WhatsApp bot flows
- FAQ and knowledge-base training
- Lead qualification
- Appointment booking
- CRM handoff
- Human escalation
- Analytics for questions, drop-offs, and conversions
